newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND MAINTAIN RECORD AGAINST WAIKATO.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND MAINTAIN RECORD AGAINST WAIKATO.

text.p: Auckland maintained their unbeaten run in the rugby Super 12 competition when they beat Waikato 26-16 under lights at the new Albany stadium on Saturday.
Auckland led 11-6 at halftime with the help of a controversial penalty try, awarded in the last 10 minutes of the half, after Waikato had weathered five five-metre scrums.
Second-half tries to Zinzan Brooke from a five-metre scrum, converted by Carlos Spencer, and winger Joeli Vidiri sealed the fate of the match.
Waikato were unlucky on several occasions when they got within metres of the Auckland line but were stopped by some solid defence.
The Blues were lucky not to concede a penalty try when halfback Ofisa Tonu'u joined a ruck from an illegal position, preventing what certainly would have been a Waikato try.
Auckland now have two wins and a draw from three games while this was Waikato's first loss in three matches.
